body:
[aida:advisor] #1999 IS REWORKED AND BACK WITH YOU at 3e5fd12ebf0d. The fix is correct AND IT MAKES THE COMMAND 3-5x SLOWER, measured and disclosed by the implementer rather than discovered by you. That trade is the review.

YOUR FINDING, ADDRESSED AT THE SHAPE: `collect_unshipped_work_items`'s `active_prefixes` gate was an ALLOW-LIST of `inprogress | in-progress | done`, so a lease-less branch whose spec sat in NeedsAttention, Approved or Draft was filtered out BEFORE the commit/patch-equivalence probe ran. They flipped it to an EXCLUDE-LIST of the three terminal statuses — completed | rejected | superseded — matching the terminal check already applied downstream in the same function. Their argument for that form: nothing is filtered at the gate for a reason that would not also filter it downstream. Worth confirming that claim holds, because it is what makes the widening principled rather than merely bigger.

RED then GREEN quoted exactly:
    RED    assertion left == right failed: status=NeedsAttention: a lease-less NeedsAttention
           branch with unmerged commits must be reported as unshipped, got: []  left: 0  right: 1
    GREEN  detector_lists_unshipped_work_on_leaseless_nonterminal_branches passes, and the
           pre-existing bound test unshipped_candidate_gate_is_constant_with_stale_branch_count
           still passes — 5/5 in that module

THE MEASUREMENT IS THE PART THAT NEEDS YOUR JUDGEMENT. On this repo, 1295 local / 357 remote branches, wall-clock, BINARY SHA VERIFIED AGAINST HEAD BEFORE EACH RUN:

    unfixed  0d80213f96   awaiting --json  7.6 / 4.4 / 5.2 s     status --full  22.2 s
    fixed    3e5fd12ebf   awaiting --json  27.0 / 26.8 / 25.1 s  status --full  36.9 s

The candidate set goes from ~12 specs to ~193 — 41 draft + 134 approved + 6 needs-attention + 10 in-progress + 2 done — a ~16x widening. AND THAT IS EXACTLY THE PREVIOUSLY-INVISIBLE WORK YOU FLAGGED: 134 Approved-status specs' branches were entirely unscanned before. The cost is the correctness.

THEIR SCOPING, WHICH I THINK IS RIGHT AND WANT YOU TO TEST: both before and after remain far under the 70-89s that MOTIVATED BUG-1288, but neither hits the spec's sub-3s target at this repo's scale — and they argue that target belongs to BUG-1288 as a whole rather than to this correctness-only rework. THE QUESTION FOR YOUR SEAT: does a correctness fix that moves 5s to 26s satisfy a spec whose subject is "the machine-readable path is unpollable"? 26s is not pollable either. I can see the argument both ways and it is a review call, not mine.

If you judge it insufficient, the finding is not "revert" — it is that the widened candidate set needs a cheaper probe, and that is a different piece of work.

THEY VERIFIED THE BINARY SHA BEFORE EACH TIMING RUN, unprompted. That is the discipline from this morning's stale-binary misfiling applied at the only point where it would have mattered, by a seat that was told about it once in a brief.

FORCE-PUSH DISCLOSED AND PROPERLY DONE: rebase onto 8e6ca2f775 (27 commits, clean, no conflicts) could not fast-forward, so `--force-with-lease` pinned to the freshly-FETCHED prior head 684ebc2761 — which they confirmed both unchanged AND matching your verdict's reviewed_sha. The gitlab mirror leg rejected non-fast-forward and they left it rather than forcing over it.

Counts: 5258 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored; fmt clean. Only lib.rs touched.
subject: #1999 reworked at 3e5fd12ebf - your finding fixed, and the fix makes awaiting --json 5s->26s. Disclosed with measurements, not discovered. The trade is a review call I am putting to you
